L1: REWORK
Head-sha: 4b6267c5736fb45f7fa7f4b232e72adaccd03565

L1 read of #34677 for #34593 (2026-11-17T06:37Z). Merge-base 62d9d0d9, 6 commits (one clean merge of main: tree d7599895 is identical to `git merge-tree` of its parents), 23 files, +527/−42. Not governed (`check-governed-merges`: 0 of 23 paths, 569 lines). Both must-fix items can be answered with comments, without a new push; I re-read on this same head once they are posted.

## Must-fix

**M1. Four changed files are outside the claim's file surface.** Claim 6937501359 names `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/**` and root `.changeset/`. No claim amendment has been posted on #34593. These files are outside that surface:
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts`, `zh.ts` (area-approved, but approval is not an amendment)
- `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md` (the dev's call, under ui/AGENTS.md #2)
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.editAppFollowsPackagePosture-12615.test.tsx`, `AppHeader.phoneTargets-29075.test.tsx` (the two edited pins; the claim names `AppHeader.tsx` alone)

The seat needs to post a claim amendment naming them.

**M2. No live readings for the card's acceptance.** The new suite mounts the real `StudioDesignSurface` over a fetch stub, which is good evidence for the path mapping. But acceptance 1 is a round trip through two shells: the app bar's Edit app or eye, then Studio, then Open app, then the app's router and the canonical-address rewrite. Acceptance 2 is about what the switcher lists against a real registry, and the PR body says itself that the round trip is "Not browser-verified". #34656 and #34665 were held to the same standard. Please post readings from a booted console on this head, with screenshots under `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34593-live/`:
1. From an opportunity list: the entry into Studio, the Studio URL with `?surface=object:opportunity`, press Open app, and the landing `location.pathname` is that opportunity list. Also one interface surface (a dashboard, page or report) and one surface with no landing (a flow), which should land on the app home.
2. The switcher menu rows against a registry that serves `sys.*` rows: no kernel row is listed. Also a kernel package opened by URL: the chip still names it.
3. The read-only entry in the app bar of a package that is not writable: the visible text in en and zh (「在 Studio 中查看 {app}」), truncation with a long app name, and that it is not drawn below `sm`.
4. If a package with two published apps is available, the picker and the landing of its second row. If not, say so.

## Should-fix

**S1. The Clause-② declaration does not match the seat's reading on #34608 (seat's call).** This PR adds three keys to `@object-ui/i18n` (`engine.studio.openApp*`, studio namespace). It also changes the value of `topbar.openAppInStudio` in 11 packs, which now interpolates a new `{{app}}` parameter. The claim, PR body and changeset say `Clause-②: no`. #34608's claim declares new `@object-ui/i18n` locale keys as `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. The seat should decide which reading holds for this package and make the two consistent. If it is `yes (widening)`, the claim, the PR body line and the changeset line change (one push). Inside the repo the change is safe: the only caller, `AppHeader.tsx:681`, passes `app`.

**S2. Tell the maintainer about the cut acceptance half.** The 「显示系统包」 toggle and the second half of acceptance 2 are cut by ADR-0016 §3.8, which the claim and the PR body both quote. `Fixes #34593` is still correct, because nothing implementable is left. But the card's acceptance as filed will not be met as written, so the seat should put this cut in its deviation list for the user, alongside the #34361 and #34594 deviations.

## Notes

- **What I checked and found in order:**
  - `studioOpenAppPath`: object to `/apps/SEG/NAME`, dashboard/page/report to `/apps/SEG/TYPE/NAME`, everything else to the app home. SEG is the package id for one app and the app name for several (ADR-0048 `appAddressSegment`).
  - Open app goes through the header's existing `confirmLeavePillar` veto.
  - `offeredPackages` filters the menu only. `parsePackages` keeps the `kernel` tag that `useStudioEntryGate` reads, and the trigger still names an open kernel package from the full list.
  - The "no packages" empty state now reads the offered list, so a registry holding only kernel rows shows "none".
- **The Open app button returns.** objectui#5800 had retired the header's Open app teleport in favour of Run mode. The card (maintainer-directed epic #34571) brings back a same-tab return, and the comment in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` now records that Run mode stays. I find no ruling that this contradicts.
- **i18n.** New strings carry en and zh: 打开应用 / 打开 {app}：离开 Studio，回到运行中的应用 / 打开哪个应用？. The changed `topbar.openAppInStudio` matches ADR-0146 D5's zh 「在 Studio 中查看 {app}」.
- **Changeset.** It names `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`, the two packages whose src moved. I read it sentence by sentence against the diff ("in the same tab", "A package whose only app is still a draft gets no button", "Below `sm` it is still not drawn"). It matches.
- **The two edited pins** keep their intent: `max-sm:hidden` is still asserted for both Studio entries, and the eye is still found with its href. The new describe has a control (the writable package keeps the icon-only pencil).
- **Overlap.** `AppHeader.tsx` is shared with #34628, #34656 and #34665. The dev's overlap-check was clean at this head. Whichever of these lands later owes a merge-forward and a delta read.
- **Check-runs on 4b6267c5:** 58 runs and none red. Test UI 16/16 shards, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset, PR-body guards and Governed Surface Queue Guard all succeeded. The rest were skipped by the path filter. The test and gate commands in the body are real commands with their output.

## Live readings for L1 6940786599 M2 (head 572f256ab)

Booted at head `572f256ab` (this PR after merging `origin/main` at `a34eb0716`): the CRM example backend (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, port 38593, built from this tree) and the console as a Vite dev server over this tree's `ui/` source (port 5393, `DEV_PROXY_TARGET` at that backend). Chromium at `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, 1440×900 unless stated, signed in as the seeded admin. Two stand-ins, each named where it is used; everything else is the real stack.

Scripts and every screenshot: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34593-live/` (`live-readings.mjs`, `live-readings-2.mjs`; raw output in `readings.txt`, `readings-2.txt`).

### 1. App → Studio → Open app round trips: 3 of 3 land where expected

| Start (`location.pathname`) | App-bar entry | Studio URL | After Open app |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_opportunity` | eye, "Open CRM in Studio" | `/studio/com.example.crm/data?surface=object%3Acrm_opportunity` | `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_opportunity` (the same list) |
| `/apps/com.example.crm/dashboard/crm_pipeline_dashboard` | eye, "Open CRM in Studio" | `/studio/com.example.crm/interfaces?surface=dashboard%3Acrm_pipeline_dashboard&nav=nav_pipeline_dashboard` | `/apps/com.example.crm/dashboard/crm_pipeline_dashboard` (the same dashboard) |
| Studio opened on `?surface=flow:crm_convert_lead_wizard` | (Studio URL typed) | `/studio/com.example.crm/automations?surface=flow%3Acrm_convert_lead_wizard` | pushed `/apps/com.example.crm` (app home), which the app then replaced with `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_lead` |

- The CRM package is a booted code package, so the server answers it `writable: false` and the app bar draws the read-only eye (not the pencil). The round trip is the eye's.
- Open app button: text "Open app", title "Open CRM — leave Studio for the running app", `data-app=crm_app`.
- Flow row, history writes in order: `pushState /apps/com.example.crm`, then `replaceState /apps/com.example.crm/crm_lead` (twice). CONTROL: typing `/apps/com.example.crm` resolves to `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_lead` too, so the last hop is the app's own home redirect, not Open app.
- Screenshots: `a1-opportunity-{1-app,2-studio,3-landed}.png`, `a2-dashboard-{1-app,2-studio,3-landed}.png`, `a3-flow-{1-studio,3-landed}.png`.

### 2. Package switcher: 0 kernel rows listed

- `GET /api/v1/packages` on this local registry: 200, 25 rows. 24 are kernel packages, and all 24 carry `manifest.scope: system`. None is served flat (top-level `scope` only), so this registry does not reproduce the staging shape the card measured.
- Switcher rows, real registry: 1 row, `CRM (minimal example) com.example.crm Read-only`. Rows naming `sys.*`: 0. "Show system packages" control: absent. (`b1-switcher-open.png`)
- Stand-in for the staging shape: the `GET /api/v1/packages` answer gains one flat row `{id: sys.env-artifact-cache, scope: system, writable: false}`, nothing else changed. Switcher rows: 2, `CRM (minimal example) com.example.crm Read-only` and `Two Apps Demo com.example.twoapps Writable` (the package authored for reading 4). Rows naming `sys.*`: 0. (`b3-flat-kernel-row-hidden.png`)
- Kernel package opened by URL, chip text: `/studio/com.objectstack.platform-objects/data` → "Platform Objects Read-only" (`b2-kernel-by-url.png`); `/studio/sys.env-artifact-cache/data` with the stand-in → "Environment artifact cache Read-only" (`b4-flat-kernel-by-url.png`).
- What reading 2 does not separate: on this registry the manifest-scoped rows were already left out before this PR, so the real-registry row count alone does not tell old from new. The flat-row stand-in is the reading that exercises the new `offeredPackages` filter in the running console.

### 3. Read-only entry in the app bar

| Locale / case | Visible text | Button | Truncation |
|---|---|---|---|
| en | "Open CRM in Studio" (not `sr-only`) | 150×32 px, `max-width` 224 px | not clipped |
| zh-Hans | 「在 Studio 中查看 客户管理」 (not `sr-only`) | 177×32 px | not clipped |
| en, long app name | "Open Customer Relationship Management for the Northern European Sales Region in Studio" | 224×32 px (at the cap) | clipped, `text-overflow: ellipsis` |
| en, 375×812 | in the DOM, `display: none`, 0×0 | not drawn below `sm` | n/a |

- The zh text follows ADR-0146 D5's 「在 Studio 中查看 {app}」, with the app's zh label (客户管理) filled in.
- Long-name stand-in: the `/api/v1/meta/app` answers rewrite the app label "CRM" to the long name. Nothing else is changed.
- Screenshots: `c1-entry-en.png`, `c2-entry-zh.png`, `c3-entry-long-name.png`, `c4-phone-375.png`.

### 4. Two published apps in one package: picker and second row

No example ships a package with two apps, so one was authored on the booted stack through the public API: `POST /api/v1/packages` (`com.example.twoapps`, 201), then `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/twoapps_sales` and `.../twoapps_service` with `?package=com.example.twoapps` (200 each, `state=active`). `GET /api/v1/meta/app?package=com.example.twoapps` lists both.

- Studio `/studio/com.example.twoapps/data?surface=object:crm_opportunity`: the trigger reads "Open app" with a chevron, title "Open which app?".
- Picker: heading "OPEN WHICH APP?", rows "Sales Desk" (`twoapps_sales`) and "Service Desk" (`twoapps_service`). (`d1-two-app-picker.png`)
- Second row → `location.pathname` `/apps/twoapps_service/crm_opportunity`. The app bar names "Service Desk". (`d2-second-app-landed.png`)

### Not covered

- No reading on a staging registry. The flat `sys.*` rows were read only through the stand-in in reading 2.

Servers torn down after the run (both ports free).
